newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trading of Wilson Neill shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Wilson Neill shares suspended.

text.p: The Market Surveillance Panel said on Friday the trading and quotation of the shares of Wilson Neill be suspended from the New Zealand Stock Exchange as from commencement of trading on December 20, 1996.

This followed reports of the placing into liquidation of the company by the High Court in Auckland on December 19, and the fact that the company would no longer be able to comply with the listing rules.
The company will remain suspended until it is delisted by the exchange in due course.
